facts.text: Deborah attended a community meetup last Friday where she shared stories and felt connected to others.

evidence.quote: I was busy too - went to a community meetup last Friday. We shared stories and it was nice to feel how connected we are.

facts.text: Deborah's yoga friends have been a significant support system, and she recalls her mother being a source of motivation during her yoga journey.

evidence.quote: My yoga pals have been my second family - we've held each other up through a lot. My mum was my biggest fan and source of motivation. She'd often come to my classes with me.
